summary.text: Mark Strong is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 47, where he has served since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
He works in sales and holds a bachelor's degree in communications and public relations from Brigham Young University.

paragraphs.text: Mark Strong earned a B.A. in communications and public relations from Brigham Young University in 1994, and his career experience includes working in sales for HOJ Innovations.
Strong has served in the Utah House since 2019.

In the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the House Economic Development and Workforce Services Committee and of the House Education Committee, and as a member of the Revenue and Taxation Committee and the Administrative Rules Review Committee.
